Sign catalogue

Sign

M65

Wells W235 · Medial

Appears in 172 texts (216 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; found at the start, middle and end of texts. In the larger ICIT corpus its Wells equivalent W235 is in 195 texts, including at Dholavira.

Project finding: The fish signs are variants of one sign Likely

Where it appears 172

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 216 objects in all carry it.

Project tests 27

Established results

  • The fish signs are variants of one signLikely

    Six fish-like signs replace each other in the same places and pair with the same neighbours. They behave like forms of one word, not like names of six different gods.

    On the findings page · experiments/core_semantics/
